rules.title: Automatic entry points must follow their actual loader contracts
自动加载入口必须符合实际 Loader 合同
Organize ordinary modules around consumers and import them explicitly
普通模块按消费者组织并显式导入
Routes handle transport contracts; services organize reusable business logic
路由处理传输合同，服务组织可复用业务
Initialization code must respect when resources and services become available
初始化代码必须遵守资源与服务的可用时机
Resource creators should manage and release their resources
资源由创建者管理并在生命周期中释放
Job execution and page rendering use their own explicit entry points
任务运行与页面渲染使用各自的显式入口
Shared modules must respect browser and server dependency boundaries
共享模块保持浏览器与服务端依赖边界
Routes Explicitly Own URLs and Server Data
URL与服务端数据由路由显式拥有
Browser Dependencies Must Not Include Server-Only Modules
浏览器依赖不得包含服务端专属模块
Verify Delivery Against the Actual Render and Deployment Mode
按实际渲染与部署模式验证交付
Do Not Present Planned Directions as Current Usage Contracts
不得将规划方向写成当前使用合同
Do not treat Schema validation as authorization, business invariants, or database constraints
不得把 Schema 校验当作授权、业务不变量或数据库约束
Declare runtime validation at supported input locations
在支持的位置声明运行时校验
Business handlers should use validated data and check conversion semantics
业务处理使用校验后的数据并核实转换语义
Express types and documentation from the same runtime contract
类型和文档从同一份运行时合同表达
A custom validation engine implements the synchronous compilation and result contract
自定义校验引擎实现同步编译与结果合同
Declare runtime JSON response Schemas in responses
JSON 运行时响应 Schema 使用 responses 声明
Use app.db only after successful database initialization
仅在数据库初始化成功后使用 app.db
Distinguish real collection names from model registration keys
区分真实集合名与模型注册键
Choose a data access entry point based on required model behavior
按所需模型行为选择数据访问入口
Verify connection pools, databases, and model scope explicitly
显式核实连接池、数据库与模型作用域
Establish transactions and concurrency constraints at business boundaries
在业务边界显式建立事务与并发约束
Distinguish database query caches from HTTP response caches
区分数据库查询缓存与 HTTP 响应缓存
A route module must provide a supported default export
路由模块必须提供受支持的默认导出
A route factory must collect routes synchronously during loading
路由工厂必须在加载时同步收集路由
Handlers should use validated and normalized data
处理器应使用已校验并归一化的数据
Route middleware must use declared names
路由级中间件必须使用已声明名称
Business code must not bypass the route-definition lifecycle to register HTTP methods
业务代码不得绕过路由定义生命周期直接注册 HTTP 方法
Implement input validation separately from authorization and business constraints
输入校验与授权、业务约束应分别实现
A route's normalized method and full path must be unique
路由的规范化方法与完整路径不能重复
Declare runtime JSON response schemas separately from documentation details
JSON 响应应把运行时 Schema 与文档说明分别声明
OpenAPI metadata must not be used as runtime access protection
OpenAPI 元数据不得作为运行时访问保护
Route overrides must respect each setting's enablement conditions and units
路由覆盖必须遵守各配置项的启用条件与单位
Application startup
应用启动集成
Schedule definitions
调度定义
Execution and overlap
执行与重叠
Replica configuration
多副本配置
Trigger deduplication
触发去重
Running leases
运行租约
Redis failures
Redis 故障
Feature scope
功能范围
Shutdown and side effects
关闭与副作用
Testing and development
测试与开发
Discovery and documentation selection
发现与文档选取
Static evidence and project state
静态证据与项目状态
Verify types, behavior, and deployable artifacts separately
分别验证类型、行为和可部署产物
Distinguish runtime mode, configuration profile, and build-time replacement
区分运行模式、配置 profile 与构建时替换
Start from valid, matching build output
从有效且匹配的构建输出启动
Deliver complete runtime artifacts for enabled features
交付启用功能需要的完整运行产物
Design multi-worker deployment around state ownership
根据状态归属设计多 worker 部署
Verify readiness, health, and bounded shutdown
验证就绪、健康与有界关闭
Assign a creator and cleanup responsibility to each long-lived resource
给每个长期资源确定创建者与关闭职责
Extension names and storage namespaces follow their owning contracts
扩展名称和存储命名空间遵循所属合同
Set resource budgets and parsing placement before accepting uploads
在接收上传前确定资源预算和解析位置
Connect identity verification to route authorization explicitly
将身份识别和路由授权显式连接
Do not treat documentation, input validation, or CORS as authorization
不得把文档声明、输入校验或 CORS 当作授权
Configure each protection according to its enablement conditions
按各机制的启用条件配置保护
Check rate-limit keys and cross-process state at the actual execution point
在实际执行位置核对限流键与跨进程状态
Partition response caches by access identity and data differences
响应缓存按访问身份和数据差异划分
